visual_identity.core_identity: An ancient skeletal spellcaster preserved by forbidden magic, combining unmistakable undead anatomy with deliberate arcane intelligence and a guarded phylactery.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall robed skeletal humanoid with narrow shoulders, exposed skull and hands, one spellcasting arm raised, robes falling in simple vertical shapes.
visual_identity.head_features: Bare or partly hooded skull with deep empty sockets or small magical pinpoints, intact jaw, severe ancient profile.
visual_identity.body_shape: Dry skeletal humanoid frame under decayed layered robes, bony hands visible, upright commanding posture.
visual_identity.surface: Clean bone planes and torn fabric edges; no gore, slime, or dense decay.
signature_gear: simple arcane staff or wand if unobtrusive
few ancient jewelry or robe fasteners
visual_identity.limb_structure: One normal skeletal humanoid body with exactly two arms/hands and two legs beneath the robes, though lower legs may be partly hidden by fabric. The skull is one humanlike skeletal head; no extra limbs, wings, horns, or animal anatomy.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one tall narrow skeletal humanoid with one skull, two bony arms/hands, and two legs concealed partly by simple vertical robes. Keep the frame dry and skeletal rather than armored, fleshy, or monstrous; spellcasting gesture comes from normal humanoid anatomy.

accuracy_checks: skull and hands are clearly skeletal

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: An ancient skeletal spellcaster preserved by forbidden magic, combining unmistakable undead anatomy with deliberate arcane intelligence and a guarded phylactery. Dry skeletal humanoid frame under decayed layered robes, bony hands visible, upright commanding posture. Clean bone planes and torn fabric edges; no gore, slime, or dense decay. Tall robed skeletal humanoid with narrow shoulders, exposed skull and hands, one spellcasting arm raised, robes falling in simple vertical shapes.

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium tall narrow skeletal humanoid whose authority comes from posture, robes, and spell gesture rather than oversized body mass.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Upright skeletal stance with normal humanoid balance; bony hands emerge clearly from simple robes for deliberate spellcasting or guarding gestures.

known_failure_modes.symptom: body gains fleshy corpse mass or wet decay
known_failure_modes.correction: strip back to dry skeletal skull/hands and narrow bone frame under decayed robes

known_failure_modes.symptom: heavy armor hides the skeletal caster identity
known_failure_modes.correction: remove full knight armor and restore exposed skull, bony hands, simple robes, and arcane gesture
